author: Zilok74
quote: TO At first glance, one might think it's the game of the century. Great graphics, good cinematics, a wait of decades. I have to say the graphics are excellent and it's fun for the first 30 minutes. It's a hyped game, clearly made to sell in bulk. It lacks the story of GTA IV, the adrenaline of GTA 5, or the aesthetic of the original Vice City. It's just the same formula, but this time more familiar. Congratulations, we waited 13 years for a hyper-realistic dating simulator, for a buggy 30fps game that repeats the same details as RD2 but with AI optimization. I'm not saying the game isn't graphically insane, but that would be its only relevant aspect. If they had released a remake of Vice City it would have been more entertaining. And the worst part is that now 10-year-olds will come asking for Game of the Year for a game that will only mark generations by the end of physical media, a new price standard for AAA games, and of course, an upcoming online mode which will be the only thing truly desirable.
